spanish: En lugar que degollarán el holocausto degollarán la culpa, y su sangre echará sobre el altar alrededor.
grammarChanges: echarán → echará: restored 3rd masculine singular to match יִזְרֹק (qal imperfect 3ms, h03007002011); plural subject was unsupported by the source verb.
degüellan → degollarán: both slaughter verbs (h03007002003, h03007002006) are qal imperfect 3mp; split present/future tense removed so both render in the same tense.
